description: Na₂Mo(HO₂)₂ crystallizes in the orthorhombic Pbca space group. There are two inequivalent Na sites. In the first Na site, Na is bonded in a 4-coordinate geometry to one H and four O atoms. The Na-H bond length is 2.64 Å. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.32-2.37 Å. In the second Na site, Na is bonded in a 5-coordinate geometry to two H and three O atoms. There is one shorter (2.51 Å) and one longer (2.67 Å) Na-H bond length. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.26-2.30 Å. Mo is bonded in a tetrahedral geometry to four O atoms. There are a spread of Mo-O bond distances ranging from 1.79-1.83 Å. There are two inequivalent H sites. In the first H site, H is bonded in a 1-coordinate geometry to one Na atom. In the second H site, H is bonded in a water-like geometry to two Na atoms. There are four inequivalent O sites. In the first O site, O is bonded in a bent 120 degrees geometry to one Na and one Mo atom. In the second O site, O is bonded in a bent 120 degrees geometry to one Na and one Mo atom. In the third O site, O is bonded in a 3-coordinate geometry to two Na and one Mo atom. In the fourth O site, O is bonded to three Na and one Mo atom to form distorted edge-sharing ONa₃Mo trigonal pyramids.
